main.description: A judgment-log batch: operations whose fold VALIDATES A PRECONDITION and DISCARDS anything that fails it (roster changes now; DtR approvals from step2 Phase 6). Kept in a separate collection from app.conversensus.graph.batch because the two folds have different semantics — graph ops resolve by LWW / add-wins and have no notion of an invalid op, while these do. rkey = v1~<fileId>~<clock, 12-digit zero-padded>~<BatchId>, the same scheme as the graph batch collection so that one file's judgments can be range-fetched from another actor's repo. The Lamport clock space is SHARED with the graph op-log: preconditions say 'recorded before this operation', so the two logs must be orderable against one another (step2 Phase 0, U6-P2 spike).

fileId.description: The file this judgment belongs to (UUID). Required for the same reason as on graph batches: the collection is repo-wide, so the record must carry its own scope.

actor.description: Lamport actor (did#deviceId). NOTE: the roster is keyed by DID, not by actor — the fold reduces actor to its DID so that a second device of the same person is not a second participant.

clock.description: Lamport logical clock, in the SAME clock space as app.conversensus.graph.batch. Do not introduce a separate counter here.

timestamp.description: Wall-clock milliseconds since epoch (display only; never used for ordering).

ops.description: Serialized JudgmentOp[]. Currently participation.genesis / .invite / .accept / .resign / .revoke; DtR approval ops join this union in step2 Phase 6.
